notes.title: Elemental War Clash 1.0.3!
notes.content:
Not much time passed and here is another little patch to fix mostly achievement related issues.

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]fixed some achievements not updating properly
[*]fixed some scenario score statistics not matching actual score because of lives being counted in there
[*]fixed sometimes crystals multiplying on savegame load
[*]fixed Saw tower not dealing any damage
[*]fixed drawing board and puzzle not working properly
[/list]
[previewyoutube=emDZdFThW5A;full][/previewyoutube]

If you have ideas or feedback in general, or just some questions, feel free to chat with us on our [url=https://discord.gg/bwnuXq9]Discord[/url] and let us know, what you think 😊

notes.title: Elemental War Clash 1.0.2!
notes.content:
After yesterday’s launch we got a bunch of feedback and of course a few small bugs were also detected. This first patch (1.0.1 was the day 1 patch if you wonder) will tackle them.

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[b]Enhancements:[/b]
[list]
[*]added HOLD info for sell button prompt
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]fixed elementals ignoring book of wisdom
[*]fixed elementals entering portal counting multiple times sometimes
[*]fixed sold towers that are still on the map still counting into gold score
[*]fixed selling towers not working while they are building
[/list]
[previewyoutube=emDZdFThW5A;full][/previewyoutube]

If you have ideas or feedback in general, or just some questions, feel free to chat with us on our [url=https://discord.gg/bwnuXq9]Discord[/url] and let us know, what you think 😊
